evidence: Across 4 future quarters and 2,000 equal review slots per policy, adjusted seller targeting found 86 late deliveries following a missed handoff deadline. Carrier-focused targeting found 225 late deliveries after on-time handoff.
next_decision: Match proposed seller coaching or carrier service review to the observed stage. With equal per-order costs, choose carrier review only above the reported relative-effectiveness crossover; estimate effects prospectively.
boundary: An on-time handoff followed by a late delivery locates delay in the observed sequence. It does not establish fault or show that an intervention prevented lateness.
